TileableVolumeNoise
Source: https://github.com/sebh/TileableVolumeNoise/tree/1f879a26b89aaa4b5a7f112f14ec149d08057661
Sebastien Hillaire with weirdfoo. Cells / Worley function: Marc-Andre Loyer.
The local NumPy port generates the Perlin-Worley R channel and packed erosion channel.
Static sky raymarcher and composition are implemented locally, not Xity code.
